Subject: Need help with a consumer complaint case

Hello, my name is Priyanka Hegde. I am a 76-year-old fashion designer living in Vadodara. I paid M/s Everest Realty Rs 87,90,000 for a flat, and the flat was handed over with serious construction defects. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 08113723885 or email priyanka.hegde@example.in.
